decisions.reason: Moving the battery connector to the back edge accommodates the existing board dimensions and mounting holes but does not change the board orientation, USB-C edge placement, mounting-hole requirements, compactness goal, or aspect ratio.
The source uses the USB-C connector as a positional reference and does not change its interface, selected part, sourceability, availability, or substitute requirements.
Changing the physical placement of the battery connector does not alter the NTC terminal, J_BAT association, thermal-protection function, or controller.
The battery connector placement decision does not change the required electrical protections, protection controller, or voltage cutoffs.
The source does not change how charge status is displayed, its GPIO, or the absence of a dedicated charge LED interface.
The battery connector relocation is unrelated to I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up board location.
The source does not alter the addressable LED family, data GPIO, power interface, or status-lighting behavior.
The physical battery connector placement does not change the 5V boost converter, enable control, default state, powered loads, or usage pattern.
